decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the 5V LED supply and required controller-to-LED level shifting.
The decision concerns the separate switched 5V LED rail and does not change the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail.
The LED supply clarification does not change the OR-ing method, participating 3.3V sources, or source-selection behavior.
The SK6812 charge-status function, GPIO, and connector circuit remain valid; LED supply and level shifting are owned by the dedicated LED power-and-logic Requirement.
The 5V LED supply and level-shifter decision does not affect the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The source does not alter the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or net-label requirements.
The source does not change the battery connector, its placement, pinout, or NTC connection.
The LED power decision has no effect on battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The battery NTC temperature-sensing method is unaffected by the 5V LED supply clarification.
The source does not change the power board's eight-layer stack.
The source does not alter board dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure fit.
The LED supply and logic-level decision does not change the TVS-based ESD protection requirement.
